Dresden - school kid threatens sixth grader with knife

In Dresden, a sixth grader was threatened by another school kid with a knife. The root of the problem seems to be a conflict between native and migrant kids.

The incident took place on May, 19th, inside the premises of the 107th high school in the neighborhood of Gruna in Dresden. This has been confirmed to the Sächsische Zeitung (ed. a Saxon newspaper) by the police. According to the newspaper, the offender is a kid attending an integration class, who was provoked by his classmates.

Just a few days after, on May, 23rd, a similar incident happened near the school. "According to the information obtained by the SZ, 6th graders were threatened again by migrant kids wielding razor blades. Some of the 6th graders suffered minor injuries. The migrant kids also thrown cigarettes at them".

The police confirmed both incidents to the SZ on Monday. More information wasn't made available given that the people involved are still underage. Parents made police reports and informed the education authority of Saxony. The investigations aren't finalized yet.

According to the SZ, the 107th high school has taken measures to deescalate the problem. It organized several meetings with the parents of the involved children to clear out prejudices, dissipate fear, and bring objectivity to the discussion.
